_comment: Versioned config for album_triage.classify_album() -- see DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-01/02. Matched case-insensitively as substrings against an album's title + description. exclude wins over include when both match. ' sign' (leading space) not 'sign' -- bare 'sign' matches 'design'; 'search and rescue' kept full-phrase rather than adding a bare 'sar' abbreviation, which matches 'anniversary'. Both checked live against the full 3,314-album corpus before adding, 2026-09-02. 'photo contest'/'photography contest'/'photo challenge' were added 2026-09-06 and REMOVED the next day (see DECISIONS.md) -- a real counter-example ('Lower Hamilton Lake', SEKI, a 2016 Facebook Photo Contest Winners entry with a clean bare 'Public domain' Constraints Information) showed 'photo contest' correlates with copyright but doesn't determine it, same failure shape as the credit-line/GrantingRights/album-trust heuristics already rejected elsewhere in this project. Per-item Constraints Information parsing and the license_confidence watermark check already handle both real risks (a genuinely PD contest entry, and a mislabeled one) correctly on their own -- do not re-add a category-level contest exclusion.
